segment_text: As requested by Client, and upon reasonable notice and approval by TIBCO, TIBCO shall maintain personnel at any of the Covered Sites. On-site personnel will perform ongoing -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 98-9-14 TIBCO Maintenance Agreement Page 3 CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION system administration, monitoring, reconfiguration and tuning, problem diagnosis, and resolution, and interfacing with Client personnel on production system issues, to the extent possible during normal business hours. These personnel shall also be responsible for the installation of new TIBCO software releases on the production system and the distribution of documentation updates.
